name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the bank account of the woman head of eligible households in Karnataka.
kannada_description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅರ್ಹ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥರಿಗೆ ನೇರ ನಗದು ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ (DBT) ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ₹2,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka
kannada_department: ಮಹಿಳಾ ಮತ್ತು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಇಲಾಖೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರ
benefits: ₹2,000 per month credited directly to woman head of family bank account
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) linked to Aadhaar without intermediary deduction
Financial independence and improved household livelihood security
eligibility_summary: Woman head of household named on BPL, Antyodaya (AAY), or APL ration cards in Karnataka. Neither the woman nor her spouse must be an income tax payer or GST filer.
kannada_eligibility_summary: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್, ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಅಥವಾ ಎಪಿಎಲ್ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥರಾಗಿ ಹೆಸರಿಸಿರಬೇಕು. ಕುಟುಂಬವು ಆದಾಯ ತೆರಿಗೆದಾರರಾಗಿರಬಾರದು.
application_steps: Confirm name as head of family on BPL / AAY / APL ration card
Visit official Seva Sindhu portal or Grama One / Karnataka One center
Authenticate with Aadhaar and enter ration card number

sources.notes: Verified official enrollment portal for Gruha Lakshmi

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
description: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders in Karnataka graduating in academic year 2022-23 onwards.
kannada_description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಪದವೀಧರರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹3,000 ಹಾಗೂ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪಾಸಾದವರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹1,500 ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗ ಭತ್ಯೆ.
department: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department, Karnataka
benefits: ₹1,500 per month for unemployed diploma holders
Tenure: Up to 2 years or until employment is secured
Free enrollment in Karnataka Skill Development Corporation training
eligibility_summary: Graduates and diploma holders domiciled in Karnataka for at least 6 years who completed studies in academic year 2022-23 or later and remain unemployed for 180 days.
kannada_eligibility_summary: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ನಿವಾಸಿಗಳು, 2022-23 ಅಥವಾ ನಂತರ ಪದವಿ/ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪಾಸಾಗಿ 180 ದಿನಗಳಿಂದ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿಯಾಗಿರುವವರು.
application_steps: Have degree/diploma certificate and marks cards ready
Log into Seva Sindhu portal and navigate to Yuva Nidhi registration
Verify Aadhaar and Karnataka study certificate
Declare current unemployment status and submit linked bank details

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
kannada_description: ದೇಶದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜಮೀನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರೈತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ₹6,000 (ಮೂರು ಕಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಲಾ ₹2,000) ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು.
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
kannada_department: ಕೃಷಿ ಮತ್ತು ರೈತರ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಭಾರತ ಸರ್ಕಾರ
benefits: ₹6,000 annual financial assistance in three installments of ₹2,000 each
Direct DBT transfer via Aadhaar payment bridge
Financial assistance for agricultural seeds, fertilizers, and seasonal expenses
eligibility_summary: All farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names. Excludes institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, income tax payers, and government servants.
kannada_eligibility_summary: ತಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗುವಳಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾದ ಜಮೀನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರೈತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು. ಆದಾಯ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಪಾವತಿದಾರರಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration
Enter Aadhaar and select State and District
Enter land survey and land record (Pahani / RTC / Khata) details
